description: Reply to an inbox conversation. The reply is sent from the original recipient address (the alias the convo arrived on) and threaded back to the contact. Show the user the reply text and get a clear yes first: it goes to a real person and cannot be unsent. Can be refused with 403 SENDING_PAUSED (workspace under review, nothing was sent, tell the user to contact support).

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

text.description: Plain text body of the reply

name: send_reply
title: Send inbox reply
